theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 33 群

items.pos: v. 鉤住；吸引 | n. 鉤子
items.colloc: hook onto 鉤住... | get hooked on 對...上癮
items.distinct: catch 抓住；接住 | clasp 緊扣
ex: The advertising campaign aims to hook potential customers.
這次廣告宣傳旨在吸引潛在客戶。
Please hook the documents together with this clip.
請用這個夾子把文件鉤在一起。
He was hooked on the idea of expanding overseas.
他對擴張海外市場的想法深深著迷。

items.pos: n. 陰涼處；色調 | v. 遮蔽
items.colloc: in the shade 在陰涼處 | a shade of 色調
items.distinct: shadow 影子（輪廓） | tint 色澤
ex: We sat in the shade during the lunch break.
午休時我們坐在陰涼處休息。
This blue paint comes in several different shades.
這種藍色油漆有幾種不同的色調。
The trees shade the parking lot from the sun.
這些樹木為停車場遮擋陽光。

items.pos: v. 避免；避開
items.colloc: avoid doing sth. 避免做某事 | avoid the issue 迴避問題
items.distinct: prevent 預防；阻止 | evade 逃避（責任或義務）
ex: We should avoid making unnecessary expenses this quarter.
本季度我們應該避免不必要的開支。
Careful planning helps to avoid potential project delays.
詳盡的規劃有助於避免潛在的專案延誤。
He tried to avoid answering the difficult question.
他試圖迴避回答那個棘手的問題。

items.pos: n. 邊界；邊緣 | v. 與...接壤
items.colloc: cross the border 越過邊界 | on the border of 在...邊緣
items.distinct: boundary 界線（抽象） | edge 邊緣
ex: The company operates across the border in Canada.
這家公司在國界另一端的加拿大營運。
Heavy traffic was reported at the national border.
據報導國界處出現嚴重交通壅塞。
The park is bordered by a long stone wall.
公園邊緣有一道長長的石牆。

items.pos: n. 個案；箱子；情況
items.colloc: in any case 無論如何 | in case of 以防萬一
items.distinct: instance 實例 | container 容器
ex: We are reviewing the case of the missing shipment.
我們正在審查遺失貨物的案件。
In case of emergency, please contact the manager.
若遇緊急情況，請聯繫經理。
They analyzed each business case before making decisions.
他們在做決定前分析了每個商業案例。

items.pos: n. 介紹；引進；序言
items.colloc: make an introduction 做介紹 | introduction to 對...的介紹
items.distinct: preface 前言（書籍） | presentation 簡報；發表
ex: The introduction of new software improved our efficiency.
新軟體的引進提升了我們的工作效率。
She made a formal introduction of the keynote speaker.
她對主講人做了正式介紹。
Please read the introduction before starting the manual.
開始閱讀手冊前請先看序言。

items.pos: n. 派對；當事人；政黨
items.colloc: third party 第三方 | hold a party 舉辦派對
items.distinct: group 團體 | side 一方（立場）
ex: The legal contract binds both parties involved.
法律合約對涉及的雙方皆具約束力。
We are hosting a retirement party for our colleague.
我們正為同事舉辦退休派對。
The third party will audit our financial records.
第三方將會稽核我們的財務紀錄。

items.pos: n. 記者；報導員
items.colloc: news reporter 新聞記者 | interview a reporter 採訪記者
items.distinct: journalist 新聞工作者 | correspondent 特派員
ex: A local reporter covered the company's annual conference.
一位當地記者報導了公司的年度會議。
The reporter asked several questions about the merger.
該記者詢問了幾個關於合併的問題。
She works as a financial reporter for the magazine.
她在該雜誌擔任財經記者。

items.pos: n. 部門；部分；章節
items.colloc: in the section of 在...部門 | a section of 一部分
items.distinct: department 部門（組織） | segment 分段
ex: Please review the financial section of the report.
請審閱報告中的財務部分。
He manages the sales section of the company.
他管理公司的銷售部門。
This section of the highway is currently under construction.
這段高速公路目前正在施工中。

items.pos: adj. 辛辣的；熱鬧的
items.colloc: spicy food 辣味食物 | extra spicy 特辣
items.distinct: hot 熱的；辣的（口語） | pungent 刺鼻的
ex: Most clients prefer less spicy dishes during lunch.
大多數客戶午餐時偏好辣度較低的餐點。
The menu features several spicy options from Thailand.
菜單上提供幾種泰式辣味選擇。
He ordered a spicy meal at the business dinner.
他在商務晚餐點了一份辛辣的餐點。

items.pos: n. 申請；應用程式；應用
items.colloc: submit an application 提交申請 | job application 求職申請
items.distinct: request 要求 | implementation 執行
ex: You must submit your job application by Friday.
你必須在週五前提交求職申請。
This mobile application helps track daily expenses.
這個行動應用程式有助於追蹤日常開銷。
The application of new technology saved significant costs.
新技術的應用節省了可觀成本。

items.pos: v. 嘗試；試圖 | n. 企圖；努力
items.colloc: make an attempt 嘗試 | attempt to do sth. 試圖做某事
items.distinct: try 嘗試（口語） | effort 努力
ex: They will attempt to resolve the issue today.
他們將嘗試在今天解決該問題。
His first attempt to launch the product failed.
他首次推出該產品的嘗試失敗了。
Management made an attempt to improve communication.
管理層嘗試改善溝通狀況。

items.pos: n. 障礙；柵欄；隔閡
items.colloc: language barrier 語言障礙 | break down barriers 打破障礙
items.distinct: obstacle 障礙物 | hurdle 難關
ex: Language barriers can hinder effective team collaboration.
語言障礙可能會阻礙有效的團隊合作。
Price is a major barrier to entering this market.
價格是進入該市場的主要障礙。
Safety barriers were installed around the construction site.
工地周圍安裝了安全防護欄。

items.pos: n. 基地；基礎 | v. 以...為基礎
items.colloc: based on 根據 | customer base 客戶群
items.distinct: foundation 地基；基礎 | headquarters 總部
ex: Our company has a strong customer base in Asia.
我們公司在亞洲擁有強大的客戶群。
The decisions are based on recent market research.
這些決定是根據近期的市場研究做出的。
We need a solid base for our future expansion.
我們需要為未來的擴張打下穩固基礎。

items.pos: adj. 位於...的；以...為基礎的
items.colloc: home-based 居家工作的 | city-based 城市為據點的
items.distinct: located 位於 | established 確立的
ex: The company is based in Taipei for better logistics.
為了更好的物流，該公司總部設在台北。
The report is based on interviews with managers.
這份報告是根據與經理們的訪談編寫的。
They provide web-based training for all employees.
他們為所有員工提供網路培訓課程。

items.pos: n. 船；小艇
items.colloc: by boat 搭船 | cargo boat 貨船
items.distinct: ship 大船（輪船） | vessel 船艦（正式）
ex: The goods were transported by boat across the river.
貨物是搭船運過河的。
They rented a boat for the corporate retreat.
他們為公司務虛會租了一艘船。
The boat arrived at the dock early this morning.
船於今天清晨抵達碼頭。

items.pos: v. 聊天；閒談 | n. 閒談
items.colloc: have a chat 聊一聊 | online chat 線上聊天
items.distinct: discuss 討論（正式） | converse 交談
ex: Let us have a quick chat about the agenda.
我們來針對議程簡單聊一下。
She was chatting with a client during the break.
她在休息時間與客戶閒聊。
We used the online chat to solve technical problems.
我們使用線上聊天解決了技術問題。

items.pos: n. 電影院；電影業
items.colloc: go to the cinema 去看電影 | local cinema 當地電影院
items.distinct: movie theater 電影院（美式） | film 電影
ex: The cinema is located near the central station.
電影院位於中央車站附近。
They are visiting the cinema for a team event.
他們正前往電影院參加團隊活動。
Modern cinema technology offers a better viewing experience.
現代電影技術提供了更好的觀影體驗。

items.pos: v. 拍手；鼓掌 | n. 拍手聲
items.colloc: clap for sb. 為某人鼓掌 | burst into applause 爆發掌聲
items.distinct: applaud 稱讚；鼓掌 | cheer 歡呼
ex: The audience began to clap after the presentation.
簡報結束後觀眾開始鼓掌。
Please clap to welcome our guest speaker onstage.
請鼓掌歡迎我們的客座講者上台。
He clapped his hands to grab everyone's attention.
他拍手以吸引大家的注意力。

items.pos: adj. 乾淨的 | v. 打掃；清理
items.colloc: keep clean 保持乾淨 | clean up 打掃乾淨
items.distinct: tidy 整潔的 | wash 洗滌
ex: It is important to keep your workspace clean daily.
每天保持工作空間乾淨很重要。
Our cleaning staff will clean the office tonight.
我們的清潔人員今晚會打掃辦公室。
The kitchen must be clean before we close.
我們打烊前廚房必須保持乾淨。
